items.title: Haywood Hillyer Interview, 1958-05-06
items.q: Remember A.J. Pierron? I remember the name vaguely.

ctx.x: I can't remember the names of the other bands, although I know we had a lot of them. The fraternities had parties and had them out at the country club every Saturday night. Uh... Remember A.J. Pierron? I remember the name vaguely. I just can't remember the name of this band. It was at, oh, just most all the good bands had one particular band that was a white band, but played... The halfway man's orchestra? No, it's not in existence now. I know they had some shoe sales and their bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo…
